why: Post-snapshot arXiv papers claim the volume conjecture proved for new classes: all hyperbolic double twist knots (2501.00225, Jan 2025), prime hyperbolic knots with up to seven crossings, and Chen-Yang's variant for Dehn-filled twist-knot manifolds at large parameters (2410.20489, Oct 2024); these are restrictions of the stated conjecture, not a different problem.
